title: Best AI Email Assistants for Small Business | Workforce AI

facts.fact: The page's comparison is based on reviewing current first-party product and pricing pages on August 25, 2026, and is not a hands-on review of every product.
facts.quote: We reviewed current first-party product and pricing pages on August 25, 2026.

facts.fact: Workforce AI (vendor claim) offers a free email drafter with no card required.
facts.quote: Workforce AI offers a free email drafter with no card required.

facts.fact: Fyxer's public pricing (as described by this page) starts with a seven-day trial rather than a permanent free email-drafting plan.
facts.quote: Its public pricing starts with a seven-day trial rather than a permanent free email-drafting plan.

facts.fact: According to this page, Superhuman Mail's Auto Drafts and business integrations are in its paid Business tier.
facts.quote: Auto Drafts and business integrations sit in its paid Business tier.

facts.fact: Workforce AI (vendor claim) states that users can add a card to try all of its Pro plan, with cancellation at any time and no surprise charge.
facts.quote: Add a card to try all of Pro, cancel anytime, no surprise charge.

facts.fact: Workforce AI (vendor claim) states it drafts from available connected context and that the owner remains responsible for the message sent.
facts.quote: Workforce AI drafts from available connected context; the owner remains responsible for the message sent.

facts.fact: The page advises that an AI email assistant should not send automatically by default and recommends starting with drafts and human review.
facts.quote: Not by default. Start with drafts and human review.
